      "informal_name": "Division Preserves Strict Inequality in Semifields",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {α : Type u_1} {b c : α} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α],\n  b < c → ∀ {a : α}, 0 < a → b / a < c / a",
      "informal_description": "In a linearly ordered semifield equipped with strict ordered ring properties, for any elements $b, c$ and positive element $a$, the inequality $b < c$ implies $\\frac{b}{a} < \\frac{c}{a}$.",

    },
    {
      "formal_name": "div_lt_div_iff₀",
      "informal_name": "Cross-Multiplication Inequality for Positive Denominators in Commutative Groups with Zero",
      "kind": "theorem",
      "type": "∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : CommGroupWithZero G₀] [inst_1 : PartialOrder G₀] [PosMulReflectLT G₀] {a b c d : G₀},\n  0 < b → 0 < d → (a / b < c / d ↔ a * d < c * b)",
      "informal_description": "For any elements $a, b, c, d$ in a commutative group with zero, if $0 < b$ and $0 < d$, then $\\frac{a}{b} < \\frac{c}{d}$ if and only if $a \\cdot d < c \\cdot b$.",

      "informal_description": "For integers $a, b, c, d$ with $b > 0$ and $d > 0$, the inequality $\\frac{a}{b} < \\frac{c}{d}$ in $\\mathbb{Q}$ holds if and only if $a \\cdot d < c \\cdot b$ in $\\mathbb{Z}$.",

items.informal_name: Division Preserves Strict Inequality in Semifields
items.type:
∀ {α : Type u_1} {b c : α} [inst : Semifield α] [inst_1 : LinearOrder α] [IsStrictOrderedRing α],
  b < c → ∀ {a : α}, 0 < a → b / a < c / a
items.informal_description: In a linearly ordered semifield equipped with strict ordered ring properties, for any elements $b, c$ and positive element $a$, the inequality $b < c$ implies $\frac{b}{a} < \frac{c}{a}$.

items.informal_name: Cross-Multiplication Inequality for Positive Denominators in Commutative Groups with Zero
items.type:
∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : CommGroupWithZero G₀] [inst_1 : PartialOrder G₀] [PosMulReflectLT G₀] {a b c d : G₀},
  0 < b → 0 < d → (a / b < c / d ↔ a * d < c * b)
items.informal_description: For any elements $a, b, c, d$ in a commutative group with zero, if $0 < b$ and $0 < d$, then $\frac{a}{b} < \frac{c}{d}$ if and only if $a \cdot d < c \cdot b$.

items.informal_name: Integer Division Inequality Equivalence via Cross-Multiplication
items.informal_description: For integers $a, b, c, d$ with $b > 0$ and $d > 0$, the inequality $\frac{a}{b} < \frac{c}{d}$ in $\mathbb{Q}$ holds if and only if $a \cdot d < c \cdot b$ in $\mathbb{Z}$.

items.informal_name: Division Inequality in Linear Ordered Groups with Zero
items.type:
∀ {G₀ : Type u_3} [inst : GroupWithZero G₀] [inst_1 : PartialOrder G₀] [PosMulReflectLT G₀] [MulPosReflectLT G₀]
  {a b c d : G₀}, a < c → d ≤ b → 0 ≤ c → 0 < d → a / b < c / d
items.informal_description: For elements $a, b, c, d$ in a linear ordered group with zero, if $a < c$, $d \leq b$, $0 \leq c$, and $0 < d$, then $\frac{a}{b} < \frac{c}{d}$.

items.type: ∀ {a b c d : ℤ}, 0 < b → 0 < d → (Rat.divInt a b ≤ Rat.divInt c d ↔ a * d ≤ c * b)
items.informal_description: For integers $a, b, c, d$ with $b > 0$ and $d > 0$, the inequality $\frac{a}{b} \leq \frac{c}{d}$ holds if and only if $a \cdot d \leq c \cdot b$.
